verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments platform with a merchant dashboard, so a built-in AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack shows an in-product assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The llms.txt and docs.md files are machine-readable documentation for external tools, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
